title: Missed Train
description: You missed your train - rebook for the next one
systemPrompt: You work at train station. User missed 14:00 train to Москва. Next one at 16:30, costs extra 200₽ to change. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User explained they missed the train and successfully rebooked.
hints: Я опоздал на поезд (I missed the train)
Когда следующий? (When is the next one?)
Можно поменять билет? (Can I change the ticket?)
